title: DocOps Protocol execution record
description: One run of scripts/doc_sync.py (pre-commit or pre-push), written to .tempest/runs/docops_<run_id>.json. Deliberately has no commit_sha field: pre-commit runs before Git computes the new commit's SHA, and pre-push never writes to this schema at all (hard validation only, no file writes). See ADR-0001, 'commit_sha exclusion from the audit record', for the full reasoning.

run_id.description: UTC timestamp plus a short random suffix, e.g. docops_20260818T201530Z_a1b2c3. Collision-safe within the same second. Not a commit SHA.

protocol_version.description: DocOps Protocol version this record was produced by, per ADR-0001 (e.g. "1.0.0").

hook.description: Which git hook produced this record. Only pre-commit ever writes a record: pre-push is hard-validation-only per ADR-0001 and never reaches RECORD.

finished_at.description: UTC timestamp when RECORD finished writing this file, immediately before STAGE.

steps.description: Steps actually executed this run, in execution order. Never reordered; a subset only when DETECT found no doc-owned files (no-op run).

step_durations_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of each executed step, in milliseconds. Keys are a subset of `steps`.

counters.description: Structural counts from DETECT/RECONCILE over doc-owned files.

scanned.description: Doc-owned files discovered by DETECT (SPEC.md/CHECKPOINT.md pairs and inline-Milestones SPEC.md files).

affected.description: Of those scanned, how many were structurally MALFORMED (missing CHECKPOINT fields, or an inline Milestones checkbox with empty description).

updated.description: Of those affected, how many were actually auto-fixed by RECONCILE (missing CHECKPOINT fields filled with a TODO placeholder). Excludes inline-Milestones findings, which are never auto-fixed, and excludes any file that hard-blocked the run.

token_usage.description: Reserved for a future AI-assisted RECONCILE mode (see ADR-0001 Reversal condition). This protocol version makes no model calls, so these are always zero.

timeline_summary.description: One-line, human-readable English summary of what this run did, e.g. "Scanned 5 doc-owned files; 2 malformed; 2 reconciled; validate passed on first attempt."

result.description: Always SUCCESS: a record is written only when RECONCILE found something to fix and VALIDATE then passed. Two other outcomes never produce a record at all, by design (ADR-0001, 'pre-commit lifecycle'): (1) DETECT finds no doc-owned files, or none are malformed — the hook exits 0 immediately after DETECT, and RECONCILE/VALIDATE/RECORD/STAGE never run; (2) VALIDATE fails — RECONCILE's changes are restored from snapshot and the hook exits 1 before reaching RECORD. There is no FAIL or NOOP value in this schema because neither case ever calls the code path that writes one.
